caption: four players, one mushroom, zero cooperation - the couch law that made 2d mario a party again.
about: New super mario bros. wii (2009) put four players into the same 2d level at once and discovered that chaos is content: bouncing off each other's heads, stealing the propeller suit, dying on purpose out of pure spite. The propeller and penguin suits round out the classic kit, and the co-op law became the template for every 2d mario since.
No windows build exists, so the platform is wii - played through dolphin, rom sourced from romsfun.
